text:
lina.support: customer reported sudden March invoice jump (INV-2026-03-67). they say dashboard shows ~12k tokens but invoice charged ~36k. they attached logs and want a quick reconciliation and root cause — can eng help?

customer-rep: forwarding customer note: they saw an app error, user hit retry, then a retry loop. they pasted this client stack: `HttpClient: Connection reset by peer -> retry` and `200 OK` responses recorded on our side.

lina.support: repro gist from customer (sanitized):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate 
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer sk-REDACTED' 
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' 
  -d '{"prompt":"summarize...","max_tokens":1024}'
```
Client saw a timeout/conn reset after ~8s and retried. they did NOT set an Idempotency-Key.

alex.eng: thanks — can you paste the ingress logs or request-ids? I want to see if we have duplicate completions recorded. if we have two successful write-to-ledger events for same logical call that's the issue.

lina.support: here are our ingress entries for that customer (timestamps UTC):
```
2026-03-12T14:02:11Z  ingress req_id=rq_AB12 src=10.4.5.6 status=200 tokens=1024 route=generate
2026-03-12T14:02:20Z  ingress req_id=rq_AB13 src=10.4.5.6 status=502 backend=runtime err=connection_reset
2026-03-12T14:02:20Z  ingress req_id=rq_AB14 src=10.4.5.6 status=200 tokens=1024 route=generate
```
(looks like client retried after reset and we served another full response)

maria.billing: that pattern would double the billed tokens if both completions were recorded against the account. does the ledger show two entries?

lina.support: ledger extract (sanitized):
```
2026-03-12 14:02:11 invoice_item INV-2026-03-67 customer=ACME tokens=1024 src_req=rq_AB12
2026-03-12 14:02:20 invoice_item INV-2026-03-67 customer=ACME tokens=1024 src_req=rq_AB14
```

eng-oncall: confirmed — two invoice_items for what looks like the same user action. root cause likely missing idempotency at the SDK/gateway boundary plus a short client-side retry after a connection reset. we should verify runtime didn't emit partial tokens then complete; but ledger shows two full entries.

alex.eng: quick triage checklist:
1) did our gateway attempt any automatic retry? (it shouldn't for POSTs without idempotency).
2) are these different req_ids from the client? yes — client retried, different req_id and no Idempotency-Key.
3) did the runtime dedupe by session or idempotency? no evidence.

billing-bot: automatic alert: potential duplicate usage detected for INV-2026-03-67. recommended action: flag for manual credit review.

maria.billing: propose: issue a partial credit for 1024 tokens while we fix dedupe. need approval from ops lead. also update invoice notes so customer sees credit.

lina.support: customer wants a permanent fix — they asked why retries billed twice. they said their engineers will add Idempotency-Key but want us to prevent this at our edge too.

eng-oncall: action items:
- short-term: apply a manual credit for one 1024 token line on INV-2026-03-67 (maria to create credit memo).
- mid-term: gateway change to treat repeated POSTs from same source within 30s with identical payload fingerprint as duplicates unless explicit Idempotency-Key present (configurable).
- long-term: instrument an ingress dedupe metric and add alert when duplicate-completion ratio > 0.5% for a customer-day.

alex.eng: i'll open an RFC for gateway dedupe and a runtime check to ignore duplicate completions when a recent completion exists for the same customer+fingerprint. will include proposed config and rollback.

maria.billing: filed credit memo CM-2026-03-9001 for INV-2026-03-67: credited 1024 tokens (~$0.51). added note: "credit for duplicate completion due to client retry after connection reset". customer notified.

customer-rep: customer response: thanks, they accepted the credit and will roll idempotency into their SDKs. asked if we can notify them when the gateway dedupe is live.

lina.support: marking resolved for now. alex/eng-oncall — please post updates to this thread when RFC lands and when metric/alert exist. :thumbsup:
